E2711

derive orphan rule: neither `` `derive T.{Trait}` `` nor `` `{Type}` `` is local.

What

derive orphan rule: neither `` `derive T.{Trait}` `` nor `` `{Type}` `` is local.

Why

A generated implementation has a clear local owner only when its derive provider or target type lives in the entry module (D-METADERIVE1=A). Two imported sides leave the entry package owning neither contract.

Fix

Define `derive T.{Trait}` or `{Type}` in the entry module.
